correctness.rationale: The path-algebra basis {ei,alpha_i,beta_i} and left/right concatenation define 3×3 strictly lower-triangular blocks with coefficients ui,ui+1,vi. Each block has ranks (2,1) iff adjacent ui nonzero, (0,0) iff ui=ui+1=vi=0, otherwise (1,0); hence common Jordan type with parameters t,z. Cyclic binary runs yield t+z≤n−2 for mixed supports and exceptional all-zero/all-one cases, proving binom(n,2)+3 attainable types and forbidding t=n−1. Local weights on transitions 00,mixed,11 give the 2×2 trace transfer polynomial. Every fixed support/zero subset defines Gm^(r+h−z)×A^(n−h), and maximizing run count proves the stratum dimensions and motivic identity. Independent path-matrix and transfer census matched all 64 (n3,q2) and 256 (n4,q2) radical elements. Formal recurrence follows Cayley–Hamilton. No claim about nonreduced closures.
